name: @avatark/episode-compiler
description: PLT-ADR-009 / STK-WO-009 Phase E: the Episode Compiler authority foundation. Consumes only a governed CertifiedInterpretation (never raw World evidence, never an uncertified candidate) and produces a deterministic, non-mutating compilation foundation -- not yet a full Episode Candidate (Phase F). Owns semantic Episode authority going forward; does not execute Episodes (@avatark/narrative-runtime, untouched), does not mutate World state, and does not certify interpretations.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
